Data Type: **mympd-ip-acl** <a href="#index-mympd_002dip_002dacl" class="copiable-link">¶</a>  
Available `mympd-ip-acl` fields are:

`allow` (default: `'()`) (type: list-of-strings)  
Allowed IP addresses.

`deny` (default: `'()`) (type: list-of-strings)  
Disallowed IP addresses.

#### Snapcast <a href="#Snapcast" class="copiable-link">¶</a>

<span id="index-Snapcast" class="index-entry-id"></span> <span id="index-multi_002droom-audio" class="index-entry-id"></span>

<a href="https://github.com/badaix/snapcast" class="uref">Snapcast</a> is a multi-room audio streaming system: `snapserver` receives audio from one or more sources and streams it to `snapclient` instances, which play it back in sync.

The following example runs `snapserver` with a single named pipe as its audio source, in addition to the default HTTP interface on port 1780 and the client-facing streaming interface on port 1704.

``` lisp
(service snapserver-service-type
         (snapserver-configuration
          (streams (list (snapserver-stream
                          (name "mpd")
                          (location "/run/snapserver/mpd"))))))
```

`snapserver` creates the named pipes of its `pipe` sources when it starts, as the ‘`snapserver`’ user; make sure the program feeding such a pipe—the `fifo` output of MPD, for instance—is allowed to write to it.

Variable: **snapserver-service-type** <a href="#index-snapserver_002dservice_002dtype" class="copiable-link">¶</a>  
The service type for `snapserver`.

<!-- -->

Data Type: **snapserver-configuration** <a href="#index-snapserver_002dconfiguration" class="copiable-link">¶</a>  
Available `snapserver-configuration` fields are:

`package` (default: `snapcast`) (type: file-like)  
The Snapcast package to use.

`user` (default: `%snapserver-user`) (type: user-account)  
Owner of the `snapserver` process.

`group` (default: `%snapserver-group`) (type: user-group)  
Owner group of the `snapserver` process.

`shepherd-requirement` (default: `'()`) (type: list-of-symbols)  
This is a list of symbols naming Shepherd services that this service will depend on.

`log-file` (default: `"/var/log/snapserver.log"`) (type: string)  
File where `snapserver` writes its log.

`log-filter` (default: `"*:info"`) (type: string)  
Log filter, given as `tag``:``level` pairs separated by commas, where `tag` is `*` or a log tag and `level` is one of `trace`, `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `error` or `fatal`.

`data-directory` (default: `"/var/lib/snapserver"`) (type: string)  
Directory where `snapserver` stores persistent data, such as client settings.

`mdns?` (default: `#t`) (type: boolean)  
Whether to publish the Snapcast services over mDNS. This requires `avahi-service-type` (see <a href="#Networking-Services" class="pxref">Networking Services</a>).

`http?` (default: `#t`) (type: boolean)  
Whether to enable the HTTP JSON-RPC interface, which also serves the Snapweb web interface.

`http-port` (default: `1780`) (type: integer)  
Port the HTTP server listens on.

`http-bind-address` (default: `"::"`) (type: string)  
Address the HTTP server listens on.

`doc-root` (type: maybe-file-like)  
Directory served by the HTTP server. It defaults to the Snapweb web interface bundled with the `package` field.

`tcp-control?` (default: `#t`) (type: boolean)  
Whether to enable the TCP JSON-RPC control interface.

`tcp-control-port` (default: `1705`) (type: integer)  
Port the TCP control interface listens on.

`tcp-streaming?` (default: `#t`) (type: boolean)  
Whether to enable TCP streaming, which is what Snapcast clients connect to.

`tcp-streaming-port` (default: `1704`) (type: integer)  
Port the TCP streaming interface listens on.

`streams` (type: list-of-snapserver-stream)  
List of `snapserver-stream` records describing the audio sources `snapserver` reads from.

`codec` (default: `"flac"`) (type: string)  
Default codec used to send audio to clients, given as `codec``[:``options``]` where `codec` is one of `flac`, `ogg`, `opus` or `pcm`.

`sampleformat` (default: `"48000:16:2"`) (type: string)  
Default sample format of the streams, given as `rate``:``bits``:``channels`.

`buffer-ms` (default: `1000`) (type: integer)  
End-to-end latency, in milliseconds.

`chunk-ms` (default: `20`) (type: integer)  
Default duration, in milliseconds, of the audio chunks read from the sources.

`send-to-muted?` (default: `#f`) (type: boolean)  
Whether to send audio to muted clients.

`extra-content` (type: maybe-string)  
Content appended verbatim to `snapserver.conf`, for options that are not covered by the fields above, such as the `[ssl]` and `[authorization]` sections.

<!-- -->

Data Type: **snapserver-stream** <a href="#index-snapserver_002dstream" class="copiable-link">¶</a>  
Available `snapserver-stream` fields are:

`name` (default: `"default"`) (type: string)  
Name of the stream, as shown by Snapcast clients.

`type` (default: `pipe`) (type: snapserver-stream-type)  
Type of the stream source: one of `pipe`, `file`, `process`, `librespot`, `airplay`, `tcp`, `alsa` or `meta`.

`location` (default: `"/run/snapserver/snapfifo"`) (type: string)  
Location of the stream source: a file name for `pipe`, `file` and `process` streams, a host name for `tcp` streams, a device name for `alsa` streams, and a slash-separated list of stream names for `meta` streams.

`codec` (type: maybe-string)  
Codec to use for this stream, overriding the `codec` field of `snapserver-configuration`.

`sampleformat` (type: maybe-string)  
Sample format of this stream, given as `rate``:``bits``:``channels`, overriding the `sampleformat` field of `snapserver-configuration`.

`chunk-ms` (type: maybe-integer)  
Duration, in milliseconds, of the audio chunks read from this source, overriding the `chunk-ms` field of `snapserver-configuration`.

`parameters` (default: `'()`) (type: alist)  
Additional source parameters, given as an association list, for example `'(("controlscript" . "meta_mpd.py"))`.
